messages:
yue: quick heads-up — onboarding "jitai-v1" int8 rollout showing locale regressions across multilang evals. saw BLEU drop ~4.2 pts ja->zh, token merges for han+kana, and bracket mirroring flip in ar/heb rtl tests :eyes:

arjun: can you paste a couple failing examples?

yue: here's the eval summary + minimal repro (truncated):

```
Eval set: ja->zh (news, 2k examples)
baseline (fp16) BLEU=32.8
jitai-int8 BLEU=28.6
diff = -4.2

Example 1:
src: "京都の駅で電車を待っている。"
ref: "在京都车站等火车。"
jitai-int8: "在京都駅等電車。"   <-- mixed kana/kanji preserved incorrectly, detok shows leftover japanese tokens in zh output

Tokenizer debug:
baseline subtoks: [ 1452 "京都" , 873 "の", 2976 "駅", ... ]
jitai-int8 subtoks: [ 1452 "京都駅", 873 "の", 2976 "等", ... ]  <-- unexpected merge of "京都"+"駅"
```

yue: also saw rtl sample:
```
src (ar): "(ملاحظات) تحتوي الأقواس على تعليمات" 
ref: "(ملاحظات) تحتوي الأقواس على تعليمات"
jitai-int8: ")ملاحظات( تحتوي الأقواس على تعليمات"  <-- mirrored brackets moved
```

ken: hmm. that looks like tokenization boundary shift not just detok. did the tokenizer vocab/merges change during conversion? :mag:

 Tiffany: we didn't touch tokenizer files. conversion pipeline did apply a quant merge table to embedding rows. could quantization of embedding centroids cause different token preference? maybe. also check libtext normalization flags (unicode bidi normalization) — conversion upgraded icu version in build: abc123 -> def456.

yue: starting bisect between commits abc123..def456 now. infra-bot started job #7621.

infra-bot: bisect job 7621 queued — point to endpoints: http://ci.internal/bisect/7621 :gear:

arjun: while bisect runs, can you run the repro with `--show-subtokens` and `--no-detok` so we can inspect raw token sequences and logits for boundary tokens? also try `--quant-mode q5` as quick check.

 yue: repro command I used:
```
python eval.py --model jitai-int8 --subset ja-zh --seed 42 --print-failed 5 --show-subtokens
```

ken: if it's embedding quantization shift, we might see top-1 token change at early positions causing downstream merges. try comparing softmax logits for the token after "京都" in both models.

 tiffany: temp mitigation: set canary to 10% and add a detok postfilter that normalizes mirrored brackets for rtl until we have root cause.

yue: ack. canary set to 10%. I'll post bisect updates here and attach diffs from `--show-subtokens` runs. TY all :pray:

ken: thanks — ping when bisect finishes or if you want me to take over the bisect logs.

yue: will do. adding @arjun and @tiffany for followups.
